key_points: Several small institutional buyers added CMI shares in early October 2026.
One institutional seller (Ferguson Wellman) reduced its position on Oct 5.
Valuation analyses suggest CMI trades near intrinsic value (~$352‑$358 per share).
Hydrogen sector notes cite CMI as having revenue growth up to 43% in some hydrogen-related businesses.
Retail interest shown via long‑dated call options (Mar 2027 710 strike, Sep 2027 400 strike).
